draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.56, the 253rd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 37th of 37 at CB. He went 214th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (253rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 passes defended in 2021, 18th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals (reserve / out). 65 career games and 12 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 3 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile), season snap share 11.9% (19th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 11.9% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, below the norm.
